subject: Urgent: Demo request — same-day window and DST conflicts
messages:
From: Olivia Mayer <olivia@fastretail.co>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: FastRetail Purchasing <purchasing@fastretail.co>
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 16:12:00 +0200
Subject: Quick same-day demo? Time-sensitive pilot decision

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you're well — sorry for the late ping. We're finalizing a pilot decision today and would really appreciate a short walk-through of Redwood Inference with our procurement and engineering leads. Is there any chance you or someone from your team can run a 30-min demo this afternoon our time (we're in Berlin, CEST)?

We know it's short notice — target time for us would be 16:00 CEST (CEST vs CET and DST has been a mess) which I think is 07:00 PT for you. If that window won't work, what's the earliest your EU/US folks can do? It would help us a lot if we can show the demo in the same afternoon — otherwise procurement likely pushes the decision to next week.

If possible we also need a recording and a short agenda for the execs who can't join.

Thanks — really appreciate any help.

Olivia Mayer
Head of Platform Partnerships
FastRetail Inc.
olivia@fastretail.co
+49 30 5555 0101
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Mayer <olivia@fastretail.co>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick same-day demo? Time-sensitive pilot decision

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and the context. I can escalate this. A few quick things:

- I want to make sure we match expectations: a 30-min focused demo + 10-minute Q&A works for us. We'll send a short agenda and record.
- 16:00 CEST = 07:00 PT this morning — that is outside normal US hours for our east/central teams but doable if we rotate. I can try to cover but I'm on calls prior; looping Connor (EU/UK overlap) to confirm immediate coverage.

Connor — can you take 16:00 CEST today? If not, please propose the earliest slot you can take and whether Aditya can cover as backup (he's on the west-coast shift).

Olivia — could you confirm the attendee list and any specific features you want covered (e.g., Dedicated vs Hosted, privacy controls, SLA)? I attached a quick draft agenda (agenda-v2.pdf) — small edit list would be helpful.

I'll hold the thread and coordinate the invite once we have confirmation.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Olivia Mayer <olivia@fastretail.co>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 16:25:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick same-day demo? Time-sensitive pilot decision

Hi all — thanks for looping me in. I can take the 16:00 CEST slot today and run a tight 30-min demo focused on Hosted API and security/compliance points. A couple of notes:

- My calendar had a standing block but I can free the 16:00–16:40 CEST window; please send the invite.
- If anything changes on very short notice and I need to drop, Aditya (cc'd) has offered to cover at ~07:30 PT (15:30 UTC) on the same day — Aditya, can you confirm you're OK as backup?
- I'll include a brief recording option and we can hit the privacy/handoff questions live (SOC2 scope, VPC/private deployment, logging retention).

On another point — Olivia, because of DST confusion we've seen in Europe/US handoffs this week, would you prefer the calendar invite show both CEST and PDT times explicitly? I can include a screenshot (attached: calendar_screenshot.png) and an ICS that pins to Berlin timezone.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com
From: Olivia Mayer <olivia@fastretail.co>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 17:40:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Quick same-day demo? Time-sensitive pilot decision

Perfect — 16:00 CEST works for our group. Please send the calendar invite with both CEST and PDT times and include a recording option. Attendees (confirmed):

- Olivia Mayer — Head of Platform Partnerships
- Markus Neumann — Procurement (will join for first 10 minutes)
- Elena Kovacs — Lead Engineer (full session)
- Purchasing distribution list (purchasing@fastretail.co)

Connor — thanks for stepping in. Jasmine — appreciate the quick coordination.

Attached I've uploaded a tiny agenda edit (agenda-v2.pdf) with two points reordered. If you can add the HubSpot deal link in the invite it helps our procurement folks (I pasted it here too).

Looking forward — see you at 16:00 CEST / 07:00 PT.

Best,
Olivia
